notes: Furnishing a home interior is Roleplay & Avatar Sim's housing territory, but the loop here is a defined repeatable task with a completion condition rather than open-ended social storytelling, which is the genre's own boundary line into Simulation — so Simulation is named second and supplies the option that carries the whole build. interior-single is the shape: the answer confirmed one room only, and that row exists precisely for a build with no exterior to generate and no transition to link, which is also why building-interior and its P3 would be wrong here rather than merely expensive. I took Simulation's Role Sim on the secondary's ticket, swapping world-open for interior-single and dropping path-road-vehicle, because what it builds — task stations plus circulation to reach them — is what filling a set of placement slots needs; trigger-task is the slots, path-circulation is the floor space keeping every slot reachable. Deciding without a user: the prompt's insistence that this is not a 2D or UI game is the thing to honour, so the player walks the room in third person and this is an ordinary walkable P0 build, not a P5 and not a SET.
